title: Quantum geometry of connected state manifolds: When diabolic points act as bridges between eigenstate manifolds
summary: Parametric Hamiltonians often exhibit point-like spectral degeneracies, called diabolic points (DPs) or conical intersections, which can lead to singularities in the Provost-Vallee metric of eigenstate manifolds. We regularise the metric by a transformation to polar coordinates and develop a formalism in which DPs act as bridges between adjacent eigenstate manifolds, glueing them into a single connected state manifold (CSM).
